2607.29190.title: CAGE: Certified Authorization under Typed-Return Uncertainty for Tool-Using Agents
2607.29190.paper_summary: Tool-using LLM agents act on typed tool returns, records pairing provenance and categorical fields with numerical values. Runtime permission gates generally authorize the observed return and action, leaving the decision unprotected against small errors in how the return was bound to its source. We ask whether a candidate action stays authorized over a declared neighborhood of plausible correctly bound returns: one admissible binding fault plus bounded numerical drift. We prove that certifying the categorical and numerical channels separately does not compose: perturbations that are safe on each channel alone can jointly turn the same action unsafe. CAGE certifies this joint neighborhood directly, enumerating the discrete branches exactly and certifying the continuous perturbation within each branch. Across synthetic, policy-as-code, regulatory, and real-transaction settings, CAGE removes the in-budget false allows that accurate pointwise gates admit, while keeping a useful fraction of decisions autonomous. When the policy is executable, CAGE-Exact certifies the policy itself; otherwise CAGE-Lip and CAGE-RS certify a learned gate under an explicit, measured fidelity assumption.
2607.29190.paper_summary_zh: 工具使用的 LLM 代理基於輸入的工具返回值進行操作，記錄配對的來源和類別字段與數值。運行時許可閘通常授權觀察到的返回和行動，對於返回如何綁定到其來源的小錯誤，決策並未受到保護。我們詢問一個候選行動是否在宣告的合理綁定返回的鄰域內保持授權：一個可接受的綁定錯誤加上有界的數值漂移。我們證明單獨認證類別和數值通道並不組合：在每個通道上安全的擾動可以共同使同一行動變得不安全。CAGE 直接認證這個聯合鄰域，準確列舉離散分支並認證每個分支內的連續擾動。在合成、政策作為代碼、監管和真實交易環境中，CAGE 消除了準確的逐點閘所允許的預算內錯誤允許，同時保持有用的一部分決策自主。當政策可執行時，CAGE-Exact 認證政策本身；否則，CAGE-Lip 和 CAGE-RS 在明確的、測量的保真假設下認證學習的閘。
